# Price the dump ticket, not the truck.

> Price a junk removal job from material weight and the landfill ticket: cubic yards, pounds per yard, dump fee per ton, special item fees, labor, travel, and the walk-away number.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
